notes.title: YOLKED Full Release Is Out Now!
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce the full release of the game YOLKED! Our team has poured their hearts and souls into creating this game, fueled by their passion and dedication, and we're excited to share it with gamers all over the world. 🥳

In this full release, we've added a brand ✨new final level✨ called "Tree" that has a completely different atmosphere than any other level in the game. Players will be challenged in new ways as they navigate this beautiful and mysterious level. 🌲

Additionally, we've included a captivating final cutscene that ties together the story of the game, providing players with a satisfying conclusion to our Egg’s journey. Furthermore, we've added many more exciting new collectibles for players to find and enjoy. Check out our lists of new features and bug fixes below to learn more about what is available in this update!

[h3]New Features ✨[/h3]
[list]
[*] Our final campaign level, Tree, is now available! 
[*] Game now supports 7 languages: English, Spanish, French, German, Brazilian Portuguese, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese
[*] Added 10+ new collectibles, including a Pixelated costume, a Glass costume and a Planet costume
[*] Added a final cutscene
[*] Updated the credits
[*] Added subtitles to voice recordings in Attic level
[*] Added a new way to get special collectibles by entering a secret code in the text field on the Collectibles menu
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes & Adjustments 🐞[/h3] 
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the chalkboard is sometimes in the wrong location during restart
[*] Fixed a bug where the user is sometimes unable to progress to Attic
[*] Fixed a bug where the player can get stuck on the ceiling fan
[*] Fixed a bug in Endless Winter where icicles would sometimes have erratic behaviors
[*] Fixed a bug where the red stop sign on the voice recorder persists after the balloon disappears in Attic
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323188/c85dbcf4b5365f4e29b6698ce8d2950a6f879f7e.gif[/img]

Thank you to everyone who has supported us along the way, and we hope you enjoy YOLKED!

notes.title: Dev Diary (4/1/23): T-minus 5 Days!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! As the release date of YOLKED approaches, the development team is working around the clock to ensure that the final product is as polished and enjoyable as possible. We are all feeling the pressure, but at the same time, we are excited to see our hard work come to fruition. 

Starting off as a team of students, we never imagined that we would be here, just two and a half weeks away from the full release of our video game. It has been a long and challenging journey, but one that we are incredibly proud of. Looking back on our early days of development, we can't believe how far we've come. It's been an experience that has brought us closer together as a team and has taught us valuable lessons about game development and teamwork. 

As we approach the final stages, we can't help but feel sentimental. This project has been a labor of love for all of us, and it's amazing to see it all come together. It's hard to believe that this project, which started as a simple idea, has become a full-fledged video game. The development team has poured their hearts into this game, and we're excited to share it with players. We can't wait to see how they will react to our creation and hope that they will enjoy playing it as much as we've enjoyed making it.

We also want to take this opportunity to express our sincere gratitude to the community for your unwavering support throughout our journey. Thank you to everyone who streamed our game and provided us with feedback. Without your support and encouragement, we would not have been able to come this far. 

T-minus 5 days!

- HardBoiled Studios

notes.title: YOLKED Full Release Announcement!
notes.notes:
Hey egg-cellent gamers! 🥚

We've got some ✨eggs-hilarating✨ news for you! YOLKED - The Egg Game is finally out of Early Access and ready for its full release on Windows PC and macOS via Steam with all new content! And that's not all... Nintendo Switch players will also join the egg-citement later this year! 🎉

So, get ready to join your favorite bouncing two-armed egg on a wild adventure to escape the mad scientist's lair filled with everyday household items turned into deadly traps, and mutant eggs ready to take you down.

You can unlock over 70+ cosmetic skins, including costumes like Devil 😈, Pineapple 🍍, Football 🏈, and Cactus 🌵 by completing achievements and exploring every nook and cranny of each rage-inducing environment. Master your controls to escape the narrowest crack, test your speedrunning skills, and climb the leaderboards to become the fastest egg in the world.

And if you've already played and loved YOLKED on your computer, you can now enjoy it on the go with your Nintendo Switch! 🎮

So, what are you waiting for? Crack open your wallet and grab YOLKED - The Egg Game on Steam now for just $6.99 USD! Don't forget to join our official [url=https://discord.gg/XrKY7jMEwW]Discord[/url] community to stay up to date with all the egg-citing news and connect with other egg-straordinary gamers like yourself!

Thanks for being part of this egg-cellent community, and we'll see you in the game!

- HardBoiled Studios

notes.title: Dev Diary (10/18/22)
notes.notes:
[b]Dev Diary (10/18/22)[/b]
Hey everyone! Hope you're all doing well! [h1]😳 It’s been a while…[/h1] Although you haven’t heard from us in these past months, we have been working 😓 very hard on YOLKED with the goal of giving you the best version of the game possible!

Some of you may have been wondering [b]why the full version of YOLKED isn't released yet.[/b] 😅 Well…there were some big changes in our lives–graduation, moving countries and job hunting that unfortunately required us to push the release date :( BUT we have a lot of BIG updates coming up that we’re really excited about and we can’t wait for you to see what we’ve been up to!



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323188/895ec138499b6a42f5c0f5915e06b7d38f84468e.png[/img]



[h2]This past year has been filled with 🐞[/h2]  bug-fixing, updating graphics, optimizing performance, increasing the number of collectibles, polishing the last two levels and implementing [b]leaderboards[/b] (can you believe it? We have leaderboards now!). We loved seeing players speedrunning Kitchen and Attic and wanted to encourage more players to challenge themselves by introducing leaderboards in the game. The leaderboards will show the 🚀 top 10 players and their times after completing Kitchen and Attic. Players will also be able to see their own times and ranking if they don’t make it to the top 10. Currently, the leaderboards show both Kitchen and Attic with two metrics, but we have plans to increase this to more metrics and more levels, including Endless Mode.

[h2]We had the idea of leaderboards a while ago,[/h2] but we were always hesitant to implement it because of how much time we thought it would take and how difficult it would’ve been to implement. However, we realized how many players would enjoy the leaderboards and also how we can easily build more content revolving around this feature, so it became one of our higher priorities 🤠. We hope this feature will encourage more players to try speedrunning the game and share speedrunning tactics in our Discord community!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323188/166a39428547a28b7a8d1a647ddae4c6805c0064.gif[/img]

On that note, [b]we have just released a new Steam update[/b] which includes this leaderboard feature and the other changes mentioned above!

[h2]Another big adjustment[/h2] we have in this update is that new collectibles have been added and all collectibles have been shuffled. Unfortunately, this means [b]everyone will lose their progress, including their collectibles[/b]. This was a very 😬 tough decision but since we added a LOT more collectibles in Kitchen, Attic, and the two hidden levels, we wanted to make sure they were placed in the most appropriate locations and paired with the best descriptions. This change meant that everyone’s 💾 save file will reset, but luckily this will only happen this one time. We’re eager to see everyone’s reactions to the new costumes and we hope you like them as much as we do!

We also have a[b] fun event coming up[/b] next week on 🎃 [b]October 21, 2022: our very first Halloween event[/b] 👻, where players will be able to unlock exclusive collectibles!

Finally, we are thrilled to announce that our new full release date will be in [b]🎉 February 2023! 🎉[/b]

[h2][b]TL;DR[/b][/h2]
A new Steam update has been released, including a new leaderboards feature!
Since we added new collectibles and shuffled them around, unfortunately everyone will lose their progress in the game
On October 21, 2022, there will be a Halloween event where players can unlock exclusive Halloween costumes!
Our new full release date is now in February 2023!

- HardBoiled Studios

notes.title: Yolked is Getting Over It meets I Am Bread with eggs
notes.notes:
A new physics-based platformer is coming to Steam Early Access later this month, and the hook is that you play as an egg with arms. Yolked is out on October 28 - and promises to scramble up the infamous likes of Getting Over It With Bennett Foddy, I Am Bread, and Heave-Ho.

Yolked is the first game from Hardboiled Studios, and while it's had a demo build available on the game's Itch.io page since last year October 28 will mark its first appearance on Steam in early access form. The developer estimates Yolked will spend around "7-8 months" in this form, before releasing properly in Spring 2022 - although this is liable to slip, as many early access games do.

The early access version of Yolked will include "the first stage and a half of the core game" and Hardboiled aims on working with the community to improve things during this time. The final version should contain at least three levels with different designs, more enemies, different game modes, and more lore - yes, there is a story in this game about negotiating a kitchen with an egg.
